projectDescription: A unified Python package providing a CLI (`nlm`) and an MCP server (`notebooklm-mcp`) for programmatic access to Google NotebookLM — enabling notebook management, source ingestion, AI-powered content generation, research automation, and AI agent integration.
keyFeatures: CLI (`nlm`) with noun-first and verb-first command styles for scripting and automation
MCP server (`notebooklm-mcp`) exposing 35 tools for AI assistants (Claude, Gemini, Cursor, etc.)
Automatic browser-based authentication using Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)
Multi-profile Google account support with isolated browser sessions
Notebook CRUD, source management (URL, text, file, Google Drive, YouTube)
Studio content generation: audio podcasts, video, reports, quizzes, flashcards, infographics, slide decks, mind maps
AI-powered web/Drive research with automatic source import
Tag and smart-select system for notebook organization
Automatic MCP server configuration via `nlm setup` for Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, and more
AI skill installation for Cline, Codex, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and other agents
WSL2 authentication support with Windows Chrome integration
publicApiSurface: nlm login / nlm login --profile / nlm login switch
notebook_list / notebook_create / notebook_get / notebook_describe / notebook_rename / notebook_delete
source_add / source_list_drive / source_sync_drive / source_delete / source_describe / source_get_content
